info.title: Statement2Muster DATEV & BMD Accounting Action
info.description: Official accounting conversion action for Statement2Muster. Enables ChatGPT to turn bank statements (PDF, CSV, image or text from American Express, Wise, PayPal, Sparkasse, Deutsche Bank, Erste Bank, Raiffeisen, etc.) into certified DATEV EXTF (Buchungsstapel Version 700 Windows-1252) and Austrian BMD NTCS 5.1 CSV files. Features automated debit/credit determination (Soll/Haben), German bank account mapping (SKR03/SKR04/BMD), financial reconciliation summary, and 100% DSGVO & Zero Durable Retention (data processed strictly in volatile RAM with 30-minute auto-purge).

post.summary: Convert bank statement transactions to certified DATEV EXTF or BMD NTCS format
post.description: Converts extracted transactions, raw statement text/CSV, or base64 PDF into official German DATEV EXTF 700 (Windows-1252, SKR03/SKR04) or Austrian BMD NTCS 5.1 format. Generates financial reconciliation summary (Debit/Credit/Balance), base64 file payload for immediate inline chat access, and an ephemeral download link. Free tier includes 3 conversions per session; unlimited with Starter (€4.90) or Pro (€29) license.

200.description: Successful conversion with download URL, base64 payload, and accounting turnover summary

400.description: Invalid request parameters or empty data

413.description: Payload or file size exceeds allowed limits

422.description: Unprocessable transaction data or zero bookings extracted

post.summary: Check license key or user email subscription status
post.description: Verifies whether a user has an active Statement2Muster Starter, Pro, or Lifetime license using their license key, Stripe checkout session ID, or registered email.

get.summary: Download generated accounting CSV file from RAM cache
get.description: Streams the generated Windows-1252 encoded DATEV or BMD file directly from volatile memory. Available for 30 minutes following conversion.

parameters.name: download_id
parameters.description: Unique ephemeral download token returned by convertStatement

200.description: Windows-1252 encoded CSV file with attachment disposition

404.description: Download link expired or purged from RAM per Zero Durable Retention policy

booking_date.description: Booking date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD or European DD.MM.YYYY format

amount.description: Signed transaction amount. Negative value represents outgoing expense / debit (Lastschrift / Ausgabe). Positive value represents incoming credit / revenue (Gutschrift / Einnahme).

currency.description: ISO 4217 Currency Code (EUR, USD, CHF, GBP)

description.description: Payment purpose, beneficiary or booking text (DATEV Buchungstext)

reference.description: Invoice number or transaction reference (DATEV Belegfeld 1)

contra_account.description: Optional pre-assigned contra account / Gegenkonto (e.g. 4900 for SKR03, 6800 for SKR04)

session_id.description: Unique ChatGPT session or conversation identifier to track free tier usage

email.description: Optional user email address to verify active Pro subscription or track quota

license_key.description: Optional Statement2Muster Pro / Starter / Lifetime license key or Stripe checkout session ID

bank_name.description: Name of card issuer or bank (e.g. American Express, Wise, PayPal, Sparkasse, Volksbank)

export_format.description: Target accounting format (datev = DATEV EXTF 700 Windows-1252, bmd = BMD NTCS 5.1)

default_bank_account.description: Bank ledger account number. Default for DATEV is 1200 (SKR03) or 1800 (SKR04). Default for BMD is 2800.

transactions.description: Array of extracted transactions from document

raw_content.description: Optional raw CSV or plaintext text if client did not extract individual items

file_base64.description: Optional base64-encoded PDF or CSV document for server-side supervised extraction

total_debit.description: Total sum of expenses / outgoing amounts (negative)

total_credit.description: Total sum of revenues / incoming amounts (positive)

is_unlimited.description: True if covered by active paid subscription

plan.description: Active plan code (starter, pro, lifetime) if licensed

conversions_used.description: Number of free conversions already used

max_free_conversions.description: Maximum allowed free conversions without license

limit_reached.description: True if free tier limit has been exhausted

download_url.description: Clickable temporary download link (valid for 30 minutes in RAM)

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded CSV content for inline presentation or Code Interpreter in ChatGPT

preview_csv.description: First 5 lines of the generated accounting file for verification

upgrade_info.description: Stripe checkout links to purchase or upgrade

license_key.description: License key, Stripe checkout session ID, or user email
